action: Call 120 immediately. Chew 300mg aspirin if not allergic and no contraindications. Keep patient calm and seated. Do NOT drive to hospital.
action_zh: 立即拨打120。如无阿司匹林过敏或禁忌，嚼服300mg阿司匹林。保持患者安静坐立。不要自行驾车去医院。

action: Call 120 immediately. Time is brain. Note the exact time symptoms started. Do NOT give food, water, or aspirin (may be hemorrhagic stroke). Keep patient NPO.
action_zh: 立即拨打120。时间就是大脑。记录症状出现的确切时间。不要进食、饮水或服用阿司匹林（可能是出血性卒中）。保持患者禁食禁水。

action: Call 120. Administer epinephrine auto-injector (EpiPen) 0.3mg IM into lateral thigh immediately if available. Lie flat with legs elevated unless respiratory distress. Repeat epinephrine every 5-15 min if no improvement.
action_zh: 拨打120。如有肾上腺素自动注射笔(EpiPen)，立即在大腿外侧肌肉注射0.3mg。平躺抬高双腿（除非呼吸困难）。如无改善每5-15分钟可重复注射。

action: Call 120. Apply firm direct pressure with clean cloth. Elevate bleeding site. Do NOT remove embedded objects. Apply tourniquet only if direct pressure fails and limb bleeding is life-threatening.
action_zh: 拨打120。用干净布料直接用力压迫止血。抬高出血部位。不要移除嵌入物。仅在直接压迫无效且肢体出血危及生命时使用止血带。

action: Call 120. If choking: perform Heimlich maneuver (abdominal thrusts). For infants: back blows and chest thrusts. If asthma/COPD: use rescue inhaler. Sit upright.
action_zh: 拨打120。如异物梗阻：进行海姆立克急救法（腹部冲击）。婴儿：背部拍击和胸部冲击。如哮喘/COPD：使用急救吸入剂。保持坐立姿势。

action: Call 120. Keep patient NPO (nothing by mouth). Do NOT give pain medication (may mask surgical signs). Monitor for shock.
action_zh: 拨打120。禁食禁水。不要给止痛药（可能掩盖手术指征）。观察是否出现休克。

action: Call 120. This may indicate sepsis — time-critical. Note temperature, heart rate, breathing rate. Keep patient warm. Monitor level of consciousness.
action_zh: 拨打120。这可能是脓毒症——时间就是生命。记录体温、心率、呼吸频率。保持患者温暖。监测意识状态。

action: Go to Emergency Department immediately. Time to surgery is critical: testicular salvage rate drops significantly after 4-6 hours. This is a surgical emergency.
action_zh: 立即前往急诊科。手术时间窗至关重要：睾丸扭转4-6小时后保留率显著下降。这是外科急症。

action: Call 120 or go to ED immediately. Suspected bacterial meningitis requires urgent lumbar puncture and IV antibiotics. Do NOT delay for imaging if clinically unstable.
action_zh: 立即拨打120或前往急诊。疑似细菌性脑膜炎需紧急腰椎穿刺和静脉抗生素。如临床不稳定，不要因等待影像检查而延误。

action: Call 120 if seizure lasts >5 minutes or repeats without recovery. Time the seizure. Clear dangerous objects. Do NOT restrain or put anything in mouth. Recovery position after seizure stops.
action_zh: 抽搐超过5分钟或反复发作未恢复意识时拨打120。记录抽搐时间。清除危险物品。不要按住患者或往嘴里塞东西。抽搐停止后置复苏体位。

action: Go to Emergency Department or ophthalmologist within hours. Sudden vision loss can indicate retinal detachment, retinal artery occlusion, or acute glaucoma — all time-sensitive.
action_zh: 数小时内前往急诊科或眼科。突发视力丧失可能提示视网膜脱离、视网膜动脉阻塞或急性青光眼——均具有时间敏感性。

action: Seek medical attention within 24 hours. Monitor platelet count and hematocrit daily. Watch for warning signs: persistent vomiting, abdominal pain, mucosal bleeding, lethargy, liver enlargement >2cm. Do NOT take NSAIDs/aspirin — use paracetamol only.
action_zh: 24小时内就医。每日监测血小板和血细胞比容。警惕警告体征：持续呕吐、腹痛、黏膜出血、嗜睡、肝肿大>2cm。不要服用NSAID/阿司匹林——只可用对乙酰氨基酚。
